newsitem.title: SWEDEN: NCC says wins 225 mln DKK order.
newsitem.headline: NCC says wins 225 mln DKK order.

text.p: Swedish construction company NCC said on Thursday it won a share worth 225 million Danish crowns of a three billion Danish crown order.

The international consortium Copenhagen Metro Construction Group, or Comet, won the order to build the first section of a subway system in Copenhagen called the Minimetro, the company said in a statement.
The project is scheduled to be completed by October 2000, NCC said.

Comet consists of NCC's Danish subsidiary NCC Rasmussen & Schiotz, British companies Tarmac Construction Ltd. and Bachy Ltd., the French company SAE International, the Italian company Astaldi and Austrian company Ilbau GmbH.
NCC Rasmussen & Schiotz joined the consortium on March 21 by taking over the 7.5 percent stake held by Christiani & Nielsen A/S.
